name: Finventions Investment Portal

web.notes: Oracle APEX application, username and password login on the deployments seen; no MFA or SSO visible before login.

api.notes: No external API described on vendor pages.

terms.notes: Deployments show internal-use and no-reproduction notices for licensed market data.

notes: White-label fund information and reporting portal on Oracle APEX used by German and Luxembourg service KVGs and administrators. Deployments: HANSAINVEST Informationsportal (HIP), HAL Investment Portal Luxembourg (likely). Aimed at fund initiators and institutional clients rather than retail LPs. Interactive reports offer CSV and PDF export.
